capabilities: Add a heatmap view to Bases
Filter which records appear on the heatmap
Select the date-based property to display
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: GitHub-contributions-style heatmap for any date-based property in your Bases tables.
problem: Bases tables list records but give no calendar-style visual overview of date-based properties like activity or habits.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on cookiecutter-obsidian-plugin.

summary: Bases view plugin that renders records as a GitHub-style heatmap of any date-based property.
